metadata.title: Open Junior issues #276-#281: 0.18.8 (evidence you can trust) then 0.19.0 (concurrency and throughput)
metadata.notes: Fan-out / fan-in per phase: manager lands the contract and shared type stubs on the phase integration branch, every coding lane branches from it in parallel (junior worktree handoffs, DeepSeek default) with only targeted checks, then one candidate merge + one full build/test gate, then a fix wave and re-gate. Lanes never touch package.json; the candidate adds new test files. Fix cycles are not pre-authored: when GATE1 or GATE2 fails, cpm-revise adds fix-wave-N (lanes fanned out from the phase integration branch, one per failure cluster) and gate-N+1, each smaller than the last, repeating fan-out / fan-in until the gate is green.

metadata.artifact: Phase-1 contract on integration/0.18.8: contracts/phase1.md (ADR retrieval rules: cited ids, applies_to path scope, title/topic match; NO_DISCRIMINATION threshold and result; whole-change judging input = diff + import graph; commandPolicy guard rules and allow-flags; budget/consent token; validate lint codes CHECK_UNFILTERED / CONTRACT_OVER_BUDGET; continuation-split proposal shape) plus type stubs landed first: commandPolicy.guards + budget/consent token fields in worker-contract.ts, PolicyEvent and ContinuationProposal receipt types in worker-receipt.ts

prerequisites.consumes: retrieval rules (cited ids, applies_to scope, title match) and AdrCheckOptions stub

metadata.artifact: adr-retrieval.ts: an ADR is always judged when the design input cites its id, when its applies_to scope covers a changed path (tools/_shared/** style globs), or when its title matches the input's topic; adrCheck uses it before ranking; tests reproduce the #276 tool-independence and claim-check cases

acceptance: junior adr check --stage design on an input that cites ADR ids judges every cited ADR
an ADR whose applies_to glob covers a changed path is always judged
an ADR whose title matches the input topic is judged even when ranking would drop it

metadata.artifact: ADR gate reports NO_DISCRIMINATION (not PASS) when nearly every row is uncertain, for both junior adr check and the per-lane adr-gate.md; decisive rows still pass or block as before; tests on a 6,153-row all-uncertain fixture

acceptance: a check where nearly every row is uncertain reports NO_DISCRIMINATION, not PASS, from junior adr check
the per-lane adr-gate.md reports NO_DISCRIMINATION for the same input
a run with decisive rows passes or blocks exactly as before

prerequisites.consumes: retrieval API (which ADRs to judge for a change)

metadata.artifact: Whole-change judging mode (junior adr check --whole-change): one judgement per ADR over the diff plus the import/$ref graph, so cross-tool imports, cross-spec $refs and one client used by several tools are visible; tests with a 3-micro-app shared-hook fixture

acceptance: junior adr check --whole-change judges each retrieved ADR once over the diff plus import/$ref graph
a hook shared by three micro-apps under tools/_shared is reported against the tool-independence ADR fixture
a cross-spec $ref between two tools is visible to the judge input

prerequisites.consumes: commandPolicy.guards type and guard rule table

metadata.artifact: Default commandPolicy guards: refuse --no-build (or mark evidence stale) after a failed or missing build in the run; refuse --no-verify, git -c core.hooksPath=..., HUSKY=0-style bypasses unless explicitly allowed; each refusal recorded as a typed PolicyEvent

acceptance: a check running tests with --no-build after a failed build in the run is refused or marked stale evidence
git -c core.hooksPath=<path>, --no-verify and HUSKY=0 are refused in workers and checks unless explicitly allowed
each refusal appears on the receipt as a typed PolicyEvent

metadata.artifact: Agent-raised budget increase or consent change needs a human-approved token, like model approval; refusal is a typed PolicyEvent; tests

acceptance: an agent-made budget increase without a human-issued token is refused with a typed PolicyEvent
an agent-made consent change without a human-issued token is refused
a human-issued token lets the same change through

metadata.artifact: junior validate / plan check lint: CHECK_UNFILTERED (whole test project/suite with no filter while owned files touch few test classes, with the suggested filtered command) and CONTRACT_OVER_BUDGET (changed-line estimate from owned files and past receipts' tokens-per-changed-line vs budget, suggests a code/test split); warn, refuse under jev.mode enforce

acceptance: junior validate warns CHECK_UNFILTERED for an unfiltered whole test project check when owned files touch few test classes, with a suggested filtered command
junior validate warns CONTRACT_OVER_BUDGET when the changed-line estimate exceeds the budget, suggesting a code/test split
both refuse under jev.mode enforce

metadata.artifact: On output_truncated or budget_exceeded the receipt carries a ContinuationProposal (remaining owned files, split suggestion); tests

acceptance: a run stopped by output_truncated carries a ContinuationProposal on its receipt
a run stopped by budget_exceeded carries a ContinuationProposal naming the remaining owned files

metadata.artifact: Docs for phase 1: ADR retrieval rules, NO_DISCRIMINATION, --whole-change; commandPolicy default guards and consent token; validate lint codes

acceptance: docs/adr-support.md describes retrieval rules, NO_DISCRIMINATION and --whole-change
docs/contracts.md describes the default commandPolicy guards, the budget/consent token and the validate lint codes

metadata.artifact: admission.ts: machine-wide slot semaphore (lock dir in user state dir, stale-holder recovery), memory/swap-out pressure gate, per-pool limits, waiting reason + admission_timeout; injected clock and fake /proc for tests

acceptance: two processes sharing the lock dir never hold more slots than the configured limit
a slot left by a dead holder is recovered
admission refuses while available memory is below machine.minAvailableMb or swap-out is above its threshold
a waiter past its bound stops with admission_timeout

metadata.artifact: Workers and check commands take an admission slot before spawning; a waiting run shows why in its status and stops with admission_timeout; tests

acceptance: a worker spawn takes an admission slot before starting
a check command takes a slot from its matching pool
a waiting run reports why it is waiting in its status

metadata.artifact: isolationSetup.warmFrom: copy (reflink when available, never symlink) obj/ and optional bin/ globs into the new worktree before checks; receipts record warm vs cold; tests

acceptance: isolationSetup.warmFrom copies the configured obj/ and bin/ globs into the new worktree and never symlinks
the receipt records whether the build was warm or cold

metadata.artifact: Check results on receipts carry an evidence identity (tree hash of touched projects, command + filter, SDK/lockfile hash) and build-vs-test time; tests

acceptance: each check result on a receipt carries an evidence identity (touched-project tree hash, command and filter, SDK/lockfile hash)
the receipt records build time and test time separately
